name: opc
description: Connect Codex to your OPC Suite workspace. Manage contacts, sales orders, inventory, accounting, HRM, payroll, projects, expense claims, and documents — all from natural language inside Codex.

interface.shortDescription: CRM, sales, inventory, accounting, HR & expense claims via AI
interface.longDescription:
OPC Suite is an all-in-one business operations platform for SMBs. With this plugin Codex can read and write contacts, leads, deals, sales orders, quotations, products, inventory, suppliers, purchases, accounting (P&L, balance sheet, journals, AR/AP), HRM (employees, leave, attendance), payroll, projects, support tickets, expense claims and the documents library — all gated by your personal API token's scopes.

After install, generate a Personal API Token at https://www.myopc.io/dashboard/settings/developer/ai-connections (pick scopes per tool, copy the token), then run `export OPC_API_TOKEN=opc_pat_...` before starting Codex. The wizard prints the exact `~/.codex/config.toml` snippet for you.
